reference:
fix: the clipboard gate was reading an unset variable (#39)

Removing the retired ASR worker's control-plane scan took the pattern the
clipboard check uses with it. The check then read an unset variable: it printed
"FORBIDDEN_PASTEBOARD: unbound variable", matched nothing, and exited zero. A
gate that looks like it is running and is not is worse than one that was never
written, and this one guards a rule with real consequences — a plain
clearContents() puts dictated text on Universal Clipboard, where it reaches
every device on the Apple ID.

Caught by the release preflight printing the error mid-run. Verified in both
directions afterwards: the script exits 1 against a deliberately planted
clearContents() and 0 once it is removed.
